statement: ∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (z : ℤ), (z • f).baseChange K = (z:K) • f.baseChange K
proof:
intro f z
rw [LinearMap.baseChange_smul]
ext w
exact (algebraMap_smul K z (f.baseChange K w)).symm
